coastal.title: B.C. man defied wildfire evacuation order, then called for help when fire grew
coastal.description: Crews responded and were able to get the man to safety, but officials are warning of the dangers of not obeying evacuation orders.

kamloops.title: Wildfire near Logan Lake prompts evacuation alerts, partial closure of highway
kamloops.description: The wildfire near Logan Lake broke out on Wednesday and the BC Wildfire Service says it is about 88 hectares in size and burning out of control.

cariboo.title: Former NHLer Tood Warriner to coach Windsor women
cariboo.description: Former NHL player Todd Warriner has been named interim head coach of the University of Windsor's women's hockey team.

all.title: Metal thieves target BC Hydro charging stations and it’s not the first time
all.description: 'They were alerted by sensors in the area that went off, alerting them of the cables being cut,' Const. Sam Zacharias with the Port Moody Police Department said.
